selected_program.name: low_max_abs
selected_program.selection: strongest mean step-50 advantage among programs beating random in all four screening regimes

unchanged_execution: on-policy pre-FFN features; exact per-layer Top-B; padding excluded; gather/scatter; real AdamW; no router learning
primary_endpoints: low_max_abs minus random sparse held-out loss at steps 50, 100, 150, and 200 in all four regimes
low_max_abs minus random sparse held-out accuracy at the same evaluations
interpolated loss at dense-fewer total cost and over available common cost points
realized active fraction and auxiliary operation estimates

decision_rules.development_level_2: low_max_abs beats random at step 200 in all four body-budget regimes
decision_rules.fresh_body_confirmation_earned: the development Level 2 condition holds without changing the program or training recipe
decision_rules.development_level_3_signal: low_max_abs beats cost-matched dense-fewer at both budgets in both bodies; fresh replication and broader regimes remain necessary for any Level 3 claim
decision_rules.no_level_3: a win over random without a matched-total-cost win over dense-fewer is not practical efficiency

prohibited: changing the selected program or adding features after seeing long-run results
calling these same-regime extensions fresh confirmation
omitting auxiliary operations from cost reporting
using dense-body quality as a substitute for sparse-deployment quality
